inlineContent.text: The SDK includes a full-text search feature. Users can search across one or
more publications and filter results by type — articles, pages, or both.
Both feed and replica editions are searchable. Replica search is more limited:
results are always pages, and each search runs against a single publication.
Feed and replica publications cannot be searched together. A
search setup supports one edition system at a time, so all publications
must be of the same kind.
